entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A nearly immortal Shivan artificer of the Ghitu tribe who studied at the Tolarian Academy, captained the Weatherlight and led the New Coalition.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Planeswalker who considers Jhoira his one true friend.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker and Jhoira's fellow student who gave up his spark to seal the time rift over Shiv.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: Person who used Jhoira to infiltrate the Academy.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Headmaster who returned to found a new Academy.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Mage with a latent spark who completed his first planeswalk with help from Teferi and Jhoira.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Another immortal with whom Jhoira had a relationship.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who defeated Teferi in battle.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Ruler battling a Phyrexian invasion in an alternate timeline.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: Foe fought by the Weatherlight crew at the Stronghold.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: Recipient of the Weatherlight from Jhoira.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian fought at the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship Jhoira captained and later restored.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Possible weapon against Belzenlok.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction led by Belzenlok.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Alliance against the second Phyrexian invasion, with Jhoira as a leader.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: Nomadic tribe of Shiv, Jhoira's people.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy on Dominaria where Jhoira studied.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Homeland of Jhoira and the Ghitu.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane of Jhoira's story.

entities.name: Thran Mana Rig
entities.description: Site on Shiv where Jhoira made a powerstone.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island where the Academy stood.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Shiv was phased out.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: Disaster that destroyed the first Academy and stranded Jhoira.

events.summary: Jhoira leaves the Ghitu of Shiv to learn artifice.
events.quote: Jhoira left her people to learn more about artifice

events.summary: Jhoira befriends Karn and names him.
events.quote: she was Karn 's first friend after his activation and gave him his name

events.summary: Kerrick uses Jhoira to infiltrate the Academy, causing the disaster that strands her on Tolaria for ten years; she saves Teferi.
events.quote: She was used by Kerrick to infiltrate the Academy.

events.summary: Jhoira becomes nearly immortal by drinking time-rift water.
events.quote: Jhoira herself became nearly immortal due to her experiences at Tolaria

events.summary: Jhoira becomes first captain of the Weatherlight and rescues refugees from Serra's Realm.
events.quote: Jhoira became the first captain of the skyship Weatherlight
who asked for her hand in marriage, though she declined

events.summary: Shiv is phased out during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: her homeland was phased out along with Teferi's

events.summary: Jhoira and Teferi return to Dominaria; Teferi gives up his spark to seal the rift over Shiv while Jhoira secretly holds his spark in a powerstone.
events.quote: Teferi gave up his planeswalker's spark to seal the time rift over Shiv

events.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser go to an alternate Urborg timeline and help Venser planeswalk home.
events.quote: Teferi and Jhoira used their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk

events.summary: Jhoira searches for Jodah and they become romantically involved, but it does not last.
Jhoira finds and rebuilds the Weatherlight and assembles a new crew against the Cabal.
events.quote: assembled a new crew to fight against the rising Cabal

events.summary: The crew learns of the Blackblade, planeswalkers reinforce them, and Jhoira returns Teferi's spark powerstone to him; they fight Yargle at the Stronghold.
events.quote: Jhoira finally found the right moment to hand over the powerstone containing Teferi's spark to its rightful owner

events.summary: Jhoira gives the Weatherlight to Shanna Sisay and returns to the Mana Rig.
events.quote: Jhoira handed the Weatherlight over to Shanna Sisay

events.summary: Jhoira serves as a leader of the New Coalition and is present in the battle against Sheoldred at the Mana Rig.
events.quote: served as one of its leaders

relations.note: Karn considers her his one true friend
relations.quote: The planeswalker Karn considers her his one and only true friend.
served as one of its leaders
nearly immortal Shivan artificer of the Ghitu tribe
